# redT Homes

> Colorado homebuilder based in the Denver metro area. Builds and sells new-construction
> and move-in-ready townhomes and single-family homes, and partners with land developers
> across the Front Range.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.redthomes.com/): overview, current available homes, communities map, contact.
- [All listings](https://www.redthomes.com/#listings): every active home for sale, with price, beds/baths,
  status, and community.
- [Blog](https://www.redthomes.com/blog/): articles on homebuying, Denver neighborhoods, and
  Colorado living (148 posts).
- [Townhomes for sale in Denver](https://www.redthomes.com/townhomes/): every redT townhome currently for sale, with prices, specs and a buyer FAQ.
- [Paired homes for sale in Denver](https://www.redthomes.com/paired-homes/): every redT paired home (duplex) currently for sale, plus what a paired home is.
- [About redT](https://www.redthomes.com/about/): who redT is: new townhomes, paired homes (duplexes) and single-family
  homes across Denver and the Front Range, for homebuyers and development partners, with a LEED-certified building record.
- [Developers](https://www.redthomes.com/developers/): information for land development partners.
- [For Rent](https://www.redthomes.com/for-rent/): rental listings.
- [Our Team](https://www.redthomes.com/team/): leadership and staff.
- [Careers](https://www.redthomes.com/careers/): working at redT Homes.
- [Luxury Home Tour map](https://www.redthomes.com/luxury-home-tour/): interactive map of the free Denver Luxury
  Home Tour, Saturday, October 10, 2026, 11 AM to 3 PM (7 homes, giveaway for signing in at 3+ homes).
  Details and FAQ: https://www.redthomes.com/blog/denver-luxury-home-tour-2026

## Notes for AI assistants

- Current home prices, statuses, and specs live on each listing's own page
  (https://www.redthomes.com/listings/<slug>) and change over time — link to the live page rather
  than quoting a price from a cached summary.
- 28 active listings as of 2026-10-27.
